messages:
harper: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's cross-region retry surge. root cause: aggressive probe timeout + immediate cipher fallback sent traffic to vintage pool -> retry amplification. posting owners/etas. pls ack.

ops-bot: postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-04-05-cipher-probe-fallback (tags: lb, dns, tls, postmortem) :page_with_curl:

jules: reading. extra detail: when the preferred pool returned 421 during cert rotation our probe logic marked it unhealthy instantly and fallback swapped to pool-b which has 40% less capacity. clients retried and we saturated pool-b.

marco: i'll take the probe tuning + capacity-aware fallback. plan: add probe hysteresis (3 attempts over 10s) and prefer capacity metric before hard failover. staging -> canary -> prod. ETA: 2026-04-12 EOD.

pat: i'll own the short mitigation: during cert rotates, suppress immediate cipher fallback and extend probe timeout to 1s for the rotation window. mitigation will have rollback toggle + alerting. ETA to implement toggle in runbook: 2026-04-07 COB.

harper: can we add a small smoke that forces region routing and validates preferred pool? example: 
```
# force-preferred-smoke.sh
for r in us-east eu-west ap-sg; do
  curl -s -H "X-Force-Region: $r" https://edge.redwood.ai/health | jq -r .pool || echo "fail $r"
done
```
include in canary gating.

jules: nice. also add an openssl check for handshake cipher to the canary CI: 
```
openssl s_client -connect edge.redwood.ai:443 -servername edge.redwood.ai < /dev/null 2>/dev/null | grep "Cipher is" || true
```

marco: i'll add metrics: fallback_count, retry_amplification_ratio, handshake_fail_rate_by_region. want alert if retry_amp > 2.0 for 5m.

certs-team: we'll coordinate cert rotation windows and publish timeline 2026-04-08. avoid overlapping heavy deploys during rotations.

ops-bot: scheduled recurring regression triage: Fridays 10:00 UTC starting 2026-04-09 for 8 weeks. invite: lb, tls, dns, oncall.

pat: short mitigation notes: when enabled -> set rollback flag, run smoke, watch retry_amp and 5xx. automation to auto-rollback if 5xx increases >0.5% in 3m (i'll own snippet).

harper: action items recap: 
- MARCO: probe hysteresis + capacity-aware failover (owner) — ETA 2026-04-12 EOD
- PAT: mitigation toggle + runbook + auto-rollback snippet (owner) — ETA 2026-04-07 COB
- JULES: add openssl handshake test to canary CI + document cert-rotation checklist (owner) — ETA 2026-04-09
- CERTS-TEAM: publish cert rotation calendar and coordinate windows (owner) — ETA 2026-04-08
- OPS-BOT: recurring regression triage scheduled (owner) — first meeting 2026-04-09 10:00 UTC

marco: i'll open PRs today and add smoke script to canary gating. linking issue when ready.

jules: acked. i'll add alert thresholds to the runbook and set dashboard panels for amplification ratio.

harper: thanks all. update the postmortem with PR links and mark any blockers for the Friday triage. i'll close thread after 24h stable canary. :white_check_mark:
